description: This file contains a static class for configuring and checking preconditions for Azure Storage tests related to Orleans Journaling. It includes methods to verify configuration settings and to set default options for storage options used in tests.

classes.name: JournalingAzureStorageTestConfiguration
classes.description: A static class providing configuration and precondition checks for Azure Storage tests in the Orleans Journaling test suite.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if necessary configuration settings are set for Azure Storage tests and skips tests if not.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults
methods.description: Configures default options for Azure Append Blob Storage based on the test configuration, setting the BlobServiceClient accordingly.
